Giving the actions on the three basis generators of sl₂(ℂ), with their bracket relations, is equivalent to giving its representation; invariant subspaces agree in both directions by linearity. H003 retains an arbitrary simultaneous integer/complex basis and stability for every divided-power generator; it does not impose the standard highest-weight basis, discreteness or a homothety condition. E001 quantifies over its own arbitrary field, additive group, module, finite-dimensional instance, natural n and Fin n operator family, with finrank n, both matrix-unit identities and invariance of arbitrary W; it does not require n>0. No algebraic closure, positive l, p≠2, or distinct reduced weights is inserted. The M binders in __signature_P are dischargeable library ports, and E001 is the supplied prepared basis dependency, not an additional project hypothesis. There is no False or internal T hypothesis in that public signature.

representations_and_conversion_obligatio.notes: Verified both directions of the endpoint correspondence. An additive subgroup of V is closed under integer scalar multiplication, hence gives precisely the proposed ℤ-submodule; conversely forgetting its integer action gives the source subgroup. A simultaneous basis in finite-dimensional V has a finite index set, so reindexing both bases by Fin q is equivalent to H003, and q=n follows from the complex basis and H002. Stability under all X_r,Y_r is equivalent to stability under their generated unital integer algebra by closure under composition, sums and integer scalars. Checked the pinned Module.End multiplication/identity, LinearMap.baseChange, tensor scalar action and LinearMap.mulLeft: products act rightmost first, red sends c⊗m to c⊗t(m), the K-action is on the first tensor factor, and mulLeft ℤ d sends c to dc. Accordingly T011 explicitly requires the tensor flip's pure-tensor formula, compatibility with the source right-factor K-action, and intertwining for every integer endomorphism. Bijectivity then supplies inverse scalar compatibility and inverse intertwining, so all subspaces, invariance assertions and nonzeroness transport in both directions. Actions contains only restrictions and their inclusion-agreement equations. Subtype injectivity forces pointwise uniqueness; T017 must construct their existence from H002/H003, including h=xy−yx. Thus universal quantification over packets is nonvacuous and equivalent to the original induced actions. raw/rawZ and matrixUnit retain the exact four factors and c_j normalization; no arbitrary matrix units are substituted. Nontrivial on this additive group is equivalent to a nonzero vector. These conversions are actual planned obligations, especially T010/T011/T017, whose bodies remain required at assembly; they are not being counted as already proved.
